player_prompt.intro:
Inwe Player {player_id} kwenye JoJoJoin, ginawo giwekwa gi giko gi 5x5 gi pamo gi seli zenye nambari 0-24.
Kwa wakati wako, weka alama yako kwenye seli yoyote tupu, mfano '[12]'.
INWE WIN kwa kupata alama zako nne mfululizo — seli nne zinazofuatana mlalo, wima, au diagonally.
Kama Player {player_id} inwe '{symbol}'; mpinzani wako ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Oketo chenro mar timo kamano e yo ma ok owinjore.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ok en cell maber. Nyaka obed e kind 0 kod 24.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Cell {cell} en gima osebed ka itiyo godo.

game_action.placed: Mwani {player_id} ameweka alama yake ({symbol}) kwenye seli {cell}.
